question: Does the fraction-label advantage persist after accounting for the observation likelihood of a majority vote?
primary_endpoint: accuracy on independent single noisy test responses
selection: minimum single-response validation log loss; first minimum wins
normalization: negative log likelihood per physical training query, omitting parameter-independent count constants
intervals: paired percentile bootstrap over devices; primary 95%, secondary descriptive pointwise 95%
scope: new simulated devices; local protocol fixed before these devices are generated, not an external preregistration
